{{Top|leg}}
'''Ewokese-Basic'''<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> was a trade language developed by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the establishment of a formal friendship with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].The trade language was a combination of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]].<ref name="DFRSB">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>
